title: PostgreSQL cluster
description: A CloudNativePG cluster: health, primary, replication, certificates, rule checks and nodes. Written by dashboard.py.

panels.title: Healthy
panels.description: The number of critical alerts of rules.yaml that fire for this database: CNPGBackupFailing, CNPGCertificateExpiring, CNPGComplianceViolation, CNPGConnectionsHigh, CNPGDataDiskFull, CNPGDatabaseDown, CNPGMetricsMissing, CNPGReplicaDown, CNPGReplicaLag, CNPGTransactionIDWraparound, CNPGWritesBlocked. An alert fires once its condition has held for its waiting time; each pod, certificate or check counts once.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~".+", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: Each instance by the node it runs on. Primary: PostgreSQL accepts writes. Not streaming: a replica that does not stream from the primary. Down, in red: CNPGReplicaDown fires for it, also when its node is lost. Writes blocked, in red: CNPGWritesBlocked fires, commits on the primary wait for a synchronous standby; reads still work.

targets.expr: sort_desc(((max by (namespace, pod) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGReplicaDown", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 - 2) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGWritesBlocked", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 - 5) or on (namespace, pod) ((max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_fencing_on{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 1) * 0 - 6) or on (namespace, pod) (((1 - max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * 2 + max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_is_wal_receiver_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 0) - 1)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) (max by (namespace, pod, node) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 + 1 or on (namespace, pod) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, max by (namespace, pod, node) (last_over_time(cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[1d])) * 0 + 1)))

panels.title: Writes blocked
panels.description: Sessions waiting right now for a synchronous standby to confirm their commit. Orange while any wait; red while CNPGWritesBlocked fires, after 10 s of waiting.

targets.expr: ((sum(cnpg_sync_replication_waiting{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on () vector(NaN)) and on () (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGWritesBlocked", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) > 0)

((sum(cnpg_sync_replication_waiting{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on () vector(NaN)) unless on () count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGWritesBlocked", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})

panels.title: Replica lag
panels.description: Largest delay of any replica's reads, in seconds: 0 when it has replayed all the WAL its primary reported. Orange over 1 s; red while CNPGReplicaLag fires, after 2 min over 15 s. Missing: no replica reports it.

targets.expr: ((max(cnpg_replica_lag_seconds{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on () vector(NaN)) and on () (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGReplicaLag", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) > 0)

((max(cnpg_replica_lag_seconds{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on () vector(NaN)) unless on () count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGReplicaLag", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})

panels.title: Rule checks
panels.description: Role and mapping violations the compliance query finds. Red while CNPGComplianceViolation or CNPGMetricsMissing fires; missing means the checks stopped reporting.

targets.expr: ((sum(max by (rule, check) (cnpg_compliance_violations{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}))) or on () vector(NaN)) and on () (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGComplianceViolation|CNPGMetricsMissing", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) > 0)

((sum(max by (rule, check) (cnpg_compliance_violations{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}))) or on () vector(NaN)) unless on () count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGComplianceViolation|CNPGMetricsMissing", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: Days until the first of the chart's server and replication certificates expires. Orange under 14 days; red while CNPGCertificateExpiring is critical, under 3 days.

targets.expr: ((min((cnpg_sample:certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"} - time()) / 86400)) or on () vector(NaN)) and on () (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGCertificateExpiring", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) > 0)

((min((cnpg_sample:certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"} - time()) / 86400)) or on () vector(NaN)) unless on () count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGCertificateExpiring", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})

panels.title: Data disks
panels.description: The fullest disk that holds an instance's data, by node. Orange over 70 %; red while CNPGDataDiskFull is critical, over 80 %, before Kubernetes evicts pods at about 85 %.

targets.expr: ((topk(1, cnpg_sample:data_disk_used_ratio{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on () vector(NaN)) and on () (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGDataDiskFull", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) > 0)

((topk(1, cnpg_sample:data_disk_used_ratio{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on () vector(NaN)) unless on () count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGDataDiskFull", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})

panels.title: Leader and replicas
panels.description: State of each instance over time. Purple is the leader (primary); a purple band moving to another node is a failover or switchover.

targets.expr: ((max by (namespace, pod) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGReplicaDown", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 - 2) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGWritesBlocked", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 - 5) or on (namespace, pod) ((max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_fencing_on{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 1) * 0 - 6) or on (namespace, pod) (((1 - max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * 2 + max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_is_wal_receiver_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 0) - 1)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) (max by (namespace, pod, node) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 + 1 or on (namespace, pod) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, max by (namespace, pod, node) (last_over_time(cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[1d])) * 0 + 1))

panels.title: Transactions per second
panels.description: Commits and rollbacks per second, per instance.

targets.expr: ((sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_xact_commit{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_xact_rollback{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (role) ((label_replace((((1 - max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * 2 + max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_is_wal_receiver_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 0) - 1) == 2, "role", "primary", "", "") * 0 + 1) or on (namespace, pod) (label_replace((((1 - max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * 2 + max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_is_wal_receiver_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 0) - 1) != 2, "role", "replica", "", "") * 0 + 1))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) (max by (namespace, pod, node) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 + 1 or on (namespace, pod) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, max by (namespace, pod, node) (last_over_time(cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[1d])) * 0 + 1))

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Open backends per instance; the dashed line is max_connections.

targets.expr: ((sum by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_backends_total{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (role) ((label_replace((((1 - max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * 2 + max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_is_wal_receiver_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 0) - 1) == 2, "role", "primary", "", "") * 0 + 1) or on (namespace, pod) (label_replace((((1 - max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * 2 + max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_is_wal_receiver_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 0) - 1) != 2, "role", "replica", "", "") * 0 + 1))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) (max by (namespace, pod, node) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 + 1 or on (namespace, pod) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, max by (namespace, pod, node) (last_over_time(cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[1d])) * 0 + 1))
max(cnpg_pg_settings_setting{name="max_connections", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})

panels.title: Longest open transaction
panels.description: Age of the oldest running transaction per instance. Long ones block vacuum.

targets.expr: ((max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_backends_max_tx_duration_seconds{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (role) ((label_replace((((1 - max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * 2 + max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_is_wal_receiver_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 0) - 1) == 2, "role", "primary", "", "") * 0 + 1) or on (namespace, pod) (label_replace((((1 - max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * 2 + max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_is_wal_receiver_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 0) - 1) != 2, "role", "replica", "", "") * 0 + 1))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) (max by (namespace, pod, node) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 + 1 or on (namespace, pod) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, max by (namespace, pod, node) (last_over_time(cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[1d])) * 0 + 1))

panels.title: Replica lag
panels.description: How far behind each replica's reads are, in seconds: 0 when it has replayed all the WAL its primary reported, else the age of the last transaction it replayed. The dashed lines are 1 s and the alert's 15 s.

targets.expr: (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_replica_lag_seconds{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) (max by (namespace, pod, node) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 + 1 or on (namespace, pod) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, max by (namespace, pod, node) (last_over_time(cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[1d])) * 0 + 1))

panels.title: Bytes not yet replayed
panels.description: WAL the primary has sent that each replica has not replayed yet.

targets.expr: (label_replace(max by (namespace, application_name) (cnpg_pg_stat_replication_replay_diff_bytes{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}), "pod", "$1", "application_name", "(.+)")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) (max by (namespace, pod, node) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 + 1 or on (namespace, pod) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, max by (namespace, pod, node) (last_over_time(cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[1d])) * 0 + 1))

panels.title: Rule checks
panels.description: Each role and mapping check from the compliance query and how many violations it finds.

targets.expr: max by (rule, check) (cnpg_compliance_violations{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of each node's CPU in use.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{id="/"}[$__rate_interval])) / max by (node) (machine_cpu_cores)

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Share of each node's memory in use (working set).

targets.expr: max by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{id="/"}) / max by (node) (machine_memory_bytes)

panels.title: Data disks
panels.description: The disk each instance keeps its data on, by node: the kubelet's stats of its data volume. Orange over 70 %; CNPGDataDiskFull is critical over 80 %.

targets.expr: sort_desc(cnpg_sample:data_disk_used_ratio{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})

panels.title: Time since last WAL archived
panels.description: On the primary. Grows when archiving to the object store fails.

targets.expr: (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_seconds_since_last_archival{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) and on (namespace, pod) ((((1 - max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * 2 + max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_is_wal_receiver_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 0) - 1) == 2)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) (max by (namespace, pod, node) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 + 1 or on (namespace, pod) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, max by (namespace, pod, node) (last_over_time(cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[1d])) * 0 + 1))

panels.title: Transaction ID age
panels.description: Oldest unfrozen transaction ID per database. Wraparound trouble starts near 2 billion.

targets.expr: max by (datname) (cnpg_pg_database_xid_age{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})

panels.title: Last backup
panels.description: Age of the newest completed base backup the Barman Cloud plugin reported in the last 2 h. Orange after 26 h, the daily schedule plus 2 h; red while CNPGBackupFailing fires.

targets.expr: ((time() - max(max_over_time(barman_cloud_cloudnative_pg_io_last_available_backup_timestamp{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[2h]) > 0)) or on () vector(NaN)) and on () (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGBackupFailing", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) > 0)

((time() - max(max_over_time(barman_cloud_cloudnative_pg_io_last_available_backup_timestamp{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[2h]) > 0)) or on () vector(NaN)) unless on () count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"CNPGBackupFailing", severity="critical", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})

panels.title: WAL archive failures
panels.description: Failed WAL archive attempts per minute on the primary.

targets.expr: (max by (namespace, pod) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_failed_count{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) * 60) and on (namespace, pod) ((((1 - max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) * 2 + max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_is_wal_receiver_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"})) or on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) == 0) - 1) == 2)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) (max by (namespace, pod, node) (cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}) * 0 + 1 or on (namespace, pod) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, max by (namespace, pod, node) (last_over_time(cnpg_collector_up{namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[1d])) * 0 + 1))
